Chapter 10: The Perennial Wanderer—Living with Openness.
Every single day, we get a fresh chance to practice this kind of openness. Think about it... maybe it's just a quick chat with a neighbor, a stroll through a city that's always changing, or even a quiet pause in the middle of a noisy crowd.
The wanderer sees the world as overflowing with stories—and treats every encounter as a new opportunity to learn something unexpected.
There's this deep sense of gratitude for the journey itself, for the people we've met along the way, and for the way differences actually bring us together instead of pulling us apart.
Now, most folks spend their lives chasing after certainty—looking for that one place they can truly call home.
But the perennial wanderer? They've discovered that home isn't a fixed spot on a map.
It's a mindset.
It's about staying curious, being compassionate, and always remaining open to change.
The truth is, the journey never really ends. There's always more out there to discover, more to understand, and more ways to grow into who we're meant to be.
